Content: model set of the resolution study (learning_rules_v12_allseeds_modal.py; same architecture
and training as this paper, 5 seeds), cross-run pair set (210,205 pairs), per-subject and mean-RDM RSA.
step4_gaps.csv: seed-mean paired gaps with 95% stimulus-bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples, seed 20261002).
rsa_seed*.csv: per-seed rho (used for the Random and BP values at 32 px; NATIVE arm only).
Only NATIVE rows are used by make_macros.py; upsampling (UPSAMPLED) results are not reported in this paper.
